findings.finding: The exact held FDLE40-021 byte is a six-page flat PDF with Request Type: Expunge printed on page 1.
findings.consequence: The build uses a measured text overlay and preserves all six pages.

findings.finding: Owner determination FL-RULE-3989 authorizes composition of the Rule 3.989 petition, sworn statement, and order from rule text.
findings.consequence: Those components are clearly recorded as composed, not official source PDFs.

findings.finding: The ordinary packet-set record requires a certificate of service on three recipients at Stage 2.
findings.consequence: The build includes a separate custom certificate component with three recipient slots and leaves names and method for filing-clerk confirmation.

findings.finding: The State Attorney certified-statement body, fingerprint-official fields, signatures, notarization, and judicial order fields are protected.
findings.consequence: The build leaves them blank and participant instructions name the completion owner.

findings.finding: Notarised signature on the FDLE application; sworn affidavit at Stage 2, notarised or sworn before a deputy clerk.
findings.consequence: The instructions distinguish the petition declaration from the separately required Rule 3.989 sworn statement and preserve the five-component packet.

findings.finding: Certificate of service on three recipients at Stage 2.
findings.consequence: The certificate-of-service component has three recipient slots and is completed only after actual service.
The participant instructions require an attorney-review stop when a hearing is required or set.
